dynamics.note: Per-node modulation of the base form by the node's live signals. energy (MEASURED) brightens emission; weight (poids, accumulated usage) enlarges; embedding orients + micro-deforms so two same-role nodes are not identical. Each is a mapBounded [inMin,inMax,outMin,outMax] tuple, applied by the renderer at draw time — never persisted as an Asset (that would be one Asset per frame). The renderer DERIVES from these bounds and invents nothing: an absent signal leaves the form at identity, and energy is applied only when the node is epistemically confident (ALIGN §3).

validation_chrome.note: The construct-honesty chrome: how a ConstructChrome's four validation axes, liveness, and receipts resolve to visual instructions. DATA, not code — the compiler does a generic block lookup + palette ROLE resolution and nothing else. TOTALITY: axis_palette covers EVERY enum value of each axis (a missing value is a coverage hole, rejected like the dynamics rayon check). HONESTY INVARIANT (data): every not_measured/unknown axis value maps to the 'fog' role here, so the compiler cannot paint confidence it was never given. No hex colors — only palette ROLES (good/warn/bad/neutral/fog), resolved by the kit palette.

radius.note: The declared domain this kit is a total function over (T-K1). roleAxis (ALIGN §5b, closed 5-role set) — this kit covers only 'actor'; space/narrative/moment/thing are explicitly out-of-radius, not silently dropped. signals — the live per-node channels it reads (each folds the {measured, absent, not_measured} tri-state into the honesty path: measured displays the channel, absent/not_measured stay at identity/fog). lod_states (dormant/aggregated/sleeping/hot) are always in the radius. |radius| = 1 role x 4 lod x 3 signals x 3 signal-states = 36.
